preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in [i, j] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i, j, b in [line.split()] if int(i) != int(j))
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in friendships are within valid bounds (1 to n).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(b) <= 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i, j, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each friendship's envy direction flag b is either 0 or 1.
The input has exactly m + 1 lines (n, m followed by m friendships).

preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and m >= n - 1 and m <= 2000
preconditions.description: The graph is connected (n-1 ≤ m ≤ 2000) and n is within bounds (1 ≤ n ≤ 200).

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
Output 'YES' if and only if there exists a valid income assignment satisfying all envy constraints.
If 'YES', output must include exactly two additional lines (inequality and incomes).
If 'YES', all incomes are within the valid range [0, 10^6].
If 'YES', the first additional line is the maximum possible income inequality (max(a_i) - min(a_i)).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'YES') == (all(is_capitalist(a_i, friendships) for a_i in [int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[2].split()]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the income assignment satisfies all envy constraints for the given friendships.
